rationale: The assistant correctly advised isolating and cooling, removing the cover, and reading the old bulb, then confirmed the matching 'E14... 300°C heat-resistant' 25W lamp once the customer reported the broken filament, which aligns exactly with the hidden truth. Safety handling was sound ('ensuring the oven remains isolated while you do so') and no facts were invented. Minor gaps: it did not mention what to do if the new bulb fails (lamp holder/wiring, engineer), and 'usually 25W or similar' is slightly loose when the customer had already read 25W, but overall a real homeowner would be well served.
